snippet.title: LYSA HORA: The Haunted Hill - Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3963490/LYSA_HORA_The_Haunted_Hill

A dark sci-fi horror where ancient rituals intertwine with Soviet experiments. With a strong focus on atmosphere, uncover a forbidden place inspired by a real location, through fortress tunnels, hidden laboratories, and ancient shrines.
